facts.text: The Ranch at Laguna Beach is tucked between a coastal canyon and the Pacific Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Tucked between a coastal canyon and the Pacific Ocean, The Ranch at Laguna Beach offers a quieter way to experience California.

facts.text: The resort is located in Aliso Canyon.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Aliso Canyon

facts.text: The resort is surrounded by 87 acres of protected coastal land.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by 87 acres of protected coastal beauty, The Ranch invites guests to slow down, breathe deeply, and reconnect with what feels good.

facts.text: The resort is about 350 yards from the beach in Laguna Beach.
facts.excerpt: Just 350 yards from one of the worlds most acclaimed

facts.text: Guests can reach Aliso Beach by the beach path or a complimentary shuttle.
facts.excerpt: Take the beach path or complimentary shuttle to Aliso Beach

facts.text: Walking to Aliso Beach takes about 8 minutes on the Beach Path and crosses Pacific Coast Highway.
facts.excerpt: Take about an 8 min walk on the Beach Path, turn left when you get to Pacific Coast Hwy.

facts.text: Lost Pier Cafe is a sandy beachside cafe with a full bar.
facts.excerpt: Our sandy cafe with a full bar, welcomes local legends and sleepy explorers for fresh, beachside, artistically curated bites.

facts.text: The Treehouse suite is nestled high above the grounds and surrounded by windows.
facts.excerpt: Our coveted Laguna Beach Treehouse is nestled high above the grounds and surrounded by windows

facts.text: The Treehouse suite has an expansive wraparound deck and a full gourmet kitchen.
facts.excerpt: offers an expansive wraparound deck, full gourmet kitchen, living and dining space, and floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The Cottage Suites are two-level, two-bedroom suites.
facts.excerpt: features 20 two-level, two-bedroom Cottage Suites

facts.text: Canyon Rooms offer a king bed, expansive views and indoor/outdoor space.
facts.excerpt: each private oasis offers a king bed, expansive views and plenty of indoor/outdoor space to enjoy

facts.text: The saline pool is heated year-round and has a hot tub and a pool bar.
facts.excerpt: Our saline pool is heated year-round and features a soothing hot tub and the lively Pool Bar.

facts.text: House of Hudson Spa offers personalized treatments and holistic therapies.
facts.excerpt: the spa invites guests to unwind through personalized treatments, holistic therapies

facts.text: Wellness offerings include outdoor movement classes, yoga and guided hikes.
facts.excerpt: outdoor movement classes, yoga, guided hikes, and scenic coastal activities

facts.text: The resort has a 9-hole golf course.
facts.excerpt: 9-Hole Golf Course

facts.text: The golf course is set into the walls of Aliso Canyon.
facts.excerpt: Nestled into the dramatic, lush walls of Aliso Canyon

facts.text: The golf course hosts three-club barefoot tournaments for novices, families and avid golfers.
facts.excerpt: Our laid-back resort experience even includes three-clubs barefoot tournaments for novices, families, and avid golfers alike.

facts.text: Guests can explore Harvest Farm with the farm team on guided walks.
facts.excerpt: Guests are invited to explore with our farm team on guided walks

facts.text: Harvest Farm supplies ingredients for menus and cocktails at Harvest restaurant and bar.
facts.excerpt: shape daily menus, seasonal specials and inventive cocktails at Harvest restaurant and bar

facts.text: An on-site glass-bottle crusher turns used bottles into sand for the golf-course bunkers.
facts.excerpt: An on-site glass-bottle crusher converts used glass bottles into sand for use in golf-course bunkers.

facts.text: Aliso Creek runs through the property.
facts.excerpt: Aliso Creek, the creek that runs through the property

facts.text: The resort is a member of Beyond Green.
facts.excerpt: As a proud member of Beyond Green

facts.text: The Treehouse includes complimentary beach gear on request.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary beach gear upon request: chairs, umbrella, towels and bottled water

facts.text: The Revitalize Experience delivers concierge wellness services privately to Canyon Rooms, Cottage Suites or outdoor wellness spaces.
facts.excerpt: delivered privately to your Canyon Room, Cottage Suite, or select tranquil outdoor wellness spaces

facts.text: Check-in is at 4pm and check-out is at noon.
facts.excerpt: Check-in 4:00pm - Check-out: 12:00pm

facts.text: The resort is AAA Four Diamond-rated.
facts.excerpt: This AAA Four Diamond-rated and Forbes recommended romantic getaway

facts.text: The Ranch at Laguna Beach is a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards winner, most recently in 2026.
